name: bayesilisk-connector-agent-contract
purpose: Guide a coding agent or LLM team to build app-specific connectors while keeping Bayesilisk core app-agnostic.
nonNegotiableBoundaries: Do not modify Bayesilisk core for one app connector.
Do not let an LLM write observedStatus.
Do not let an LLM write passed.
Do not let prose-only context generate probes; proposalRules, proposalGates, or connectorActionGraph sequenceRules are required.
Do not connect to production systems or use production data.
Do not open issues from connector output alone; use Bayesilisk verified issue payloads.
sourceContextFactRequiredFields: proposalRules or matching proposalGates, unless using connectorActionGraph.sequenceRules

allowedAgentSteps.description: Read local tests, route handlers, schemas, TODOs, and product rules. Produce source facts with explicit proposal rules or connector action graphs.
Call propose_probes over MCP or `python3 -m bayesilisk --probe-proposals-output`.
Run app-specific Playwright/API code against local fixtures only. Map connectorAction to real app behavior.
Call run or issue_payloads with observed evidence.
Create issues or patch code only from Bayesilisk verified findings and issue payloads.

sourceContextFactTemplate.title: Resource action validates target identifier

expectedBehavior.description: Unknown target IDs should return not found.

nearbyTests: direct route returns 404 when the target ID is missing
sourceContextFactTemplate.sourceText: TODO: force 404 when targetId is not found.

observedFactTemplate.title: Unknown target identifier must not open protected action
observedFactTemplate.failureDetail: Unknown target ID was ignored and the protected action was visible.

abagTokenRules: Use universal ABAG tokens in connectorActionGraph requires, produces, requiresState, and paramBindings when a workflow motif may be reusable.
Keep app-specific nouns in resourceType and refines, not in token.
Use refines for the concrete connector token that app-specific execution code understands.
Bayesilisk matches typed dependencies by token plus optional resourceType, never by refines.
Action-graph requires, produces, requiresState, and paramBindings must use typed ABAG token objects.
abagMotifExamples: create resource -> transition lifecycle state -> replay old identifier across boundary
create privileged context -> downgrade/revoke privilege -> reuse stale session
create scoped object -> swap tenant/user id -> access through valid route
submit action -> navigate back/retry -> duplicate submission
create invitation -> revoke invitation -> accept invitation token
